name: OIDC My Citizen Profile Flanders
description: Integrates Drupal login with the Flemish Government ACM/IDM (My Citizen Profile) via OpenID Connect.
project_description:
Provides integration with ACM, IDM and "Mijn Burgerprofiel" of the Flemish Government.

 Back to top 

 ACM authentication 
 The ACM OpenID Connect Client realm enables users to authenticate using ACM .

 Back to top 

 IDM support 
 All local account will be audience specific. So when a user logs in as him/herself and later as a representative of an organization, 2 local accounts will be created. This allows you to manage audience specific permissions.

 It's also possible to map any IDM roles to Drupal roles, which will be automatically assigned or revoked when a user logs in.

 Back to top 

 Toolbar 
 If enabled, the "Mijn Burgerprofiel" toolbar will automatically be added on top of the page. 

 Back to top
